VBAT 11.1 V from SW1: load 10.916 A typical, 32.216 A peak; source 35 A cont, 70 A peak; fuse 20 A
5V 5 V from U5: load 0 A typical, 0 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 20 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator_5v), F3 2 A (branch computer), F4 2 A (branch actuator_bus), F5 3 A (branch lf_coxa_actuator),
F6 3 A (branch lm_coxa_actuator), F7 3 A (branch lr_coxa_actuator), F8 3 A (branch rr_coxa_actuator), F9 3 A (branch rm_coxa_actuator), F10 3 A (branch
rf_coxa_actuator). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (actuator_bus_hub, star_ground, splice_vbat) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
